ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The above graph shows a titration curve of a weak base titrated with a strong acid. The pH was measured with a pH meter after small volumes of 0.075 M HCl were added to 25.0 mL of a weak base. Data from that experiment are shown in the graph. Which arrow points to the place on the curve where the pH is equal to 14 - $pK_b$?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is the volume of HCl added, and the vertical axis is pH; the titration curve starts from the basic region at about pH 11, slowly decreases as HCl is added, shows a steep vertical drop at slightly above 20 mL, and then enters a low pH plateau. Arrows A, B, C, and D are located in the buffer region before the steep drop, with C at about 10–11 mL; E points near the steep drop, and F points to the acidic plateau after the steep drop. Reasoning: When a weak base is titrated with a strong acid, at the half-equivalence point there is [weak base] = [conjugate acid], therefore pOH = pK_b, so pH = 14 - pK_b. In the figure, the equivalence point is at the center of the steep vertical drop, about 21–22 mL; the half-equivalence volume is about 10–11 mL. This position corresponds to arrow C.

method.method_draft: First inspect the image: the curve starts at basic pH and has a sharp vertical fall centered a little above 20 mL, marking the equivalence point. Take half of that equivalence volume, roughly 10–11 mL. Match this x-position to the labeled arrows; arrow C lies at about this volume on the buffer-region curve. Therefore the arrow is C.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中横轴是加入 HCl 的体积，纵轴是 pH；滴定曲线从约 pH 11 的碱性区域开始，随 HCl 加入缓慢下降，在略高于 20 mL 处出现陡直下降，之后进入低 pH 平台。箭头 A、B、C、D 位于陡降前的缓冲区，其中 C 大约在 10–11 mL；E 指向陡降附近，F 指向陡降后的酸性平台。推理：弱碱用强酸滴定时，在半当量点有 [弱碱] = [共轭酸]，因此 pOH = pK_b，所以 pH = 14 - pK_b。图中当量点在陡直下降的中心，约为 21–22 mL；半当量体积约为 10–11 mL。这个位置对应箭头 C。

planner_metadata.image_role: Use the graph to locate the acid volume at complete neutralization from the inflection/center of the sharp drop, approximately 22 mL, and compare arrow positions along the volume axis. The point at half the neutralization volume, about 11 mL, corresponds to arrow C.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to establish that added HCl neutralizes the weak base stoichiometrically and that the desired expression is pH = 14 - pKb.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Before equivalence the solution is a buffer containing weak base B and conjugate acid BH+. Henderson-Hasselbalch in base form gives pOH = pKb + log([BH+]/[B]). The requested pH = 14 - pKb means pOH = pKb, so [BH+] = [B], which occurs after enough HCl has converted exactly half of the original base to BH+. That is half the equivalence volume.
